description: Overrides and driver type mapping through pgx, held to the same Go types as database/sql: money as text; timetz, which pgx has no codec for, as a string; bit and varbit as strings read through a cast to text (pgx decodes their binary form only into its own Bits); an interval slot set to string read through a cast to text; arrays of timestamps, dates, decimals and bytes; and a column override on a numeric[] column naming the elements' type everywhere; and an override naming the Go 1.27 standard library's uuid.UUID binds and reads.
